decisions.decision: Use the '博物馆展签' visual direction as the locked static basis for the figures page.
decisions.rationale: User selected the second visual direction after iterative exploration.

decisions.decision: Search figure names, article titles, and topic names with three Supabase/Postgres ILIKE '%query%' substring queries, merging typed results. Do not support typo tolerance, pinyin, aliases, simplified/traditional conversion, or complex ranking in the first release. The topic directory lists push articles filtered by topic; the figure directory opens figure pages and filters only by dynasty. Each directory defaults to seven entries and each filter affects only its own directory.
decisions.rationale: User defined the discovery, bounded first-release search behavior, and truncation requirements.

decisions.decision: Article navigation moves left on entry and right on return; an in-page centered circular indicator represents loading.
decisions.rationale: User defined the navigation motion and loading treatment.
